group.Description: Electrode lead: name without trailing contact number

long_name.Description: Second column of the anatomy table of the release (long electrode name)

anatomy.Description: Fourth column of the anatomy table (automatic FreeSurfer-style anatomical label, as released)

row_in_source_table.Description: Row number in <EC n>_TDT_elecs_all_warped.mat. Rows whose name/type are 'NaN' in the release (placeholders with an identical dummy position) are listed as unlabeled_row<k> with n/a coordinates. The paper refers to electrodes by number (e.g. insula 53, 54, 3, 2, 21, 16); the release does not document how rows map to TDT channels ch001..
